claim_summary: For every configuration-model multigraph from a uniformly random complete pairing of distinguishable stubs with nonnegative degrees \(d_i\), even total \(N=\sum_i d_i\ge6\), let \(L\) count loops and \(P=\sum_{i<j}\binom{X_{ij}}{2}\) count parallel nonloop edge pairs. Write \(a_i=\binom{d_i}{2}\), \(S=\sum_i a_i\), \(T=\sum_{i<j}a_i a_j\), and \(W=\sum_{i<j}a_i a_j(2d_i+2d_j-6)\). Then \(\operatorname{Cov}(L,P)=2(4ST-(N-1)W)/[(N-1)^2(N-3)(N-5)]\). It is zero exactly when \(T=0\). For \(T>0\), it is positive exactly when at least three vertices have degree two and every other degree is zero; in every other case it is strictly negative. In the \(d\)-regular pairing model on \(v\) vertices with \(vd\ge6\) even, the covariance equals \(v(v-1)\binom{d}{2}^2[2vd(2-d)+4d-6]/[(vd-1)^2(vd-3)(vd-5)]\); for \(d=2\) it is asymptotic to \(1/(8v^2)\), but for each fixed \(d\ge3\) it is asymptotic to \(-(d-1)^2(d-2)/(2dv)\).
scientific_integrity: Exact finite matching probabilities, an explicit nonnegative triple-polynomial inequality, and 70,950 standalone exact checker assertions; infinite correctness is supported by proof rather than finite enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the unconditioned half-edge pairing multigraph and a parallel-edge-pair statistic, not the simple-graph model or the indicator of multiple edges. Prior work contains overlapping exact compatibility calculations; complete historical priority and independence of the review are not established.
title: The degree-two exception for loop–parallel-pair covariance in configuration models
